'''Senoloro''' was an island [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]].

==History==
Established on an equatorial island, surrounded by six inland seas, Senoloro was the largest city on on Auratera. Largely populated by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], Senoloro's economy was driven by agriculture and trade. Containing the world's largest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the city was the landing place of most offworld freighters, as few as they were. The government of Senoloro was autocratic, ruled by a [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] who was appointed for life. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Lerella Rosral/Legends|Lerella Rosral]] held the high office, earning the contempt of her constituents due to her power grabs.<ref name="NoP" />
